info.title: TaskFlow API
info.description: REST API for TaskFlow, a task and project tracker (personal portfolio project). Authenticate with the httpOnly `tf_token` cookie or an `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Test-only endpoints under `/api/test/*` exist only when `NODE_ENV=test` and are not documented here.

delete.summary: Remove a user (admin; not self or protected accounts)

post.summary: Invite by email (existing users are added immediately; nothing is emailed)

delete.summary: Remove a member (owner/admin; unassigns their tasks)

get.summary: List tasks in a project (filter, search, sort)
List tasks across visible projects (use assignee=me for My tasks)

patch.summary: Update a task (also used for drag-and-drop moves)

get.summary: Counts, charts data, overdue and my tasks
